emb-early-neural.title: Neural plate, folds and neural crest
emb-early-neural.creator: NikNaks
emb-early-neural.scopeLimit: Shows neural-fold convergence, tube formation and neural-crest separation. It does not show the complete timeline of embryonic folding, gastrulation or secondary neurulation.

emb-msk-head.title: Pharyngeal arch arteries, pouches and cranial nerves
emb-msk-head.view: Reconstructed human pharyngeal regions across Carnegie stages 11–14
emb-msk-head.creator: Anthony Graham
emb-msk-head.scopeLimit: Shows changing spatial relationships of arch arteries, pharyngeal pouches and cranial nerves. It is not a complete arch-derivative table or a dissection view.

emb-msk-head.title: Limb-bud anterior–posterior patterning
emb-msk-head.view: Vertebrate limb-patterning schematic, anterior above posterior
emb-msk-head.creator: Fred the Oyster; based on the experimental model discussed by Harfe et al. (2004)
emb-msk-head.scopeLimit: Illustrates a classic experimental Shh patterning model and descendants of Shh-expressing cells. It is not a human gestational-age chart or a complete explanation of limb formation.

emb-thoracoabdominal.title: Heart-tube development and chamber partitioning
emb-thoracoabdominal.view: Sequential schematic views of early heart formation and septation
emb-thoracoabdominal.creator: OpenStax College
emb-thoracoabdominal.scopeLimit: Shows heart-tube fusion, looping and simplified chamber partitioning. It does not depict every septal component, congenital variation or real embryonic specimen.

emb-thoracoabdominal.title: Intestinal herniation and morphogenesis
emb-thoracoabdominal.view: Left-sided and ventral views; conventional rotation model compared with hierarchical looping
emb-thoracoabdominal.creator: Soffers, J.H., Hikspoors, J.P., Mekonen, H.K. et al.
emb-thoracoabdominal.scopeLimit: Contrasts the conventional rotation description with a research-based hierarchical-looping account. The panels use different viewpoints and should retain the original figure caption and source context.

emb-urogenital-applied.title: Pronephros, mesonephros and metanephric induction
emb-urogenital-applied.creator: Ashley Sawle (Vagus)
emb-urogenital-applied.scopeLimit: Shows transient nephric structures, ureteric budding and metanephric mesenchyme. It is not a human week-by-week staging chart, mature nephron atlas or congenital-anomaly diagnostic figure.

emb-urogenital-applied.title: External genital development and homology
emb-urogenital-applied.view: Historical paired male/female developmental illustrations from Gray’s Anatomy
emb-urogenital-applied.creator: Henry Vandyke Carter, after Ecker–Ziegler models; Gray’s Anatomy (1918), plate 1119
emb-urogenital-applied.scopeLimit: An archival anatomical illustration of external genital differentiation. Original terminology is historical; use a current course atlas for preferred terminology, normal variation and precise developmental timing.

emb-placenta-fetal.title: Placental organization and the maternal–fetal interface
emb-placenta-fetal.view: Uterine/fetal-membrane overview with enlarged placental vascular section
emb-placenta-fetal.creator: OpenStax College
emb-placenta-fetal.scopeLimit: Shows placental villi, membranes, cord vessels and the maternal blood space. It is a simplified diagram, not placental histology or a normal-variation atlas.

emb-placenta-fetal.title: Fetal circulation and the three shunts
emb-placenta-fetal.view: Fetal vascular overview with enlarged cardiac and hepatic pathways
emb-placenta-fetal.creator: OpenStax College
emb-placenta-fetal.scopeLimit: Shows fetal vascular routes and the ductus venosus, foramen ovale and ductus arteriosus. Colors simplify mixing and oxygenation; the figure is not a hemodynamic simulation.
